answer: Bind each agent identity to one physical chip. At registration its TPM signs an endorsement key, proving it runs on real hardware. Each epoch it presents a fresh quote of its boot state, so one chip carries only one identity. A duplicate quote burns the attacker's stake and blacklists the chip. Forging a thousand fake agents needs a thousand chips, about $40,000 in hardware plus days of setup. It is like building with timber: a house stands on real beams, not painted scenery, and a haven with no hidden doors leaves a fake army on the horizon nowhere to hide.
